description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the LDAPUserSyncAPI, which is part of the LDAP module in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. The class includes tests for methods such as getOne, create, and validation of LDAP configuration preconditions. It utilizes traits and mock data for integration testing, and contains helper functions to manipulate LDAP sync status and configuration settings.

classes.name: LDAPUserSyncAPITest
